description: This file contains utility functions for thread management, including thread creation, setting thread names, retrieving thread names, and mutex initialization and locking/unlocking, specifically tailored for different operating systems like Linux, macOS, Android, and uClibc.

classes.name: TaskWrapper
classes.description: Structure used to wrap a task function, its argument, and thread name for thread creation with name setting.

methods.name: setThreadName
methods.description: Sets the name of a thread based on platform-specific APIs, with support for Linux, macOS, Android, and uClibc.

methods.name: wrappedTask
methods.description: Wrapper function for executing a task with thread name setting, used internally during thread creation.

methods.name: createDetachedThread
methods.description: Creates a new thread in detached state, optionally with a name, wrapping the task if necessary.

methods.name: createThread
methods.description: Creates a new thread with specified thread ID, task, argument, and optional name.

methods.name: getThreadName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a thread, supporting platforms like Linux, Android, and macOS.

methods.name: mutexInitWithType
methods.description: Initializes a pthread mutex with a specified type, upgrading PTHREAD_MUTEX_NORMAL to PTHREAD_MUTEX_ERRORCHECK for safety.

methods.name: _mutexLock
methods.description: Locks a mutex with error checking and logs errors before aborting on failure.

methods.name: _mutexUnlock
methods.description: Unlocks a mutex with error checking and logs errors before aborting on failure.
